messages:
Priya S: :rotating_light: alert from monitoring - us-west-2 AZC (azc) edge-proxy pool reporting sharp 5xx spike, customer-facing errors ~18% across the region. paging oncall now.
IncidentBot: PAGER P-7842 created for us-west-2 proxy health spike; severity tentative SEV2. Incident channel: #incidents.
Sam K: Oncall (frontend) - I'm taking it. any recent deploys to edge proxies?
Maria V: No deploys from product. autoscaling triggered but several instances never passed ELB health checks.
Jordan P: Looking at node metrics - seeing EBS iowait skyrocketing on ~8 of 20 proxies in azc. dmesg shows repeated write timeouts. Suspect noisy EBS volume or instance-level IO stall.
OpsBot: ELB target group tg-edge-azc-1: unhealthy 12/20 -> 5/20 over last 5m. Health check path /_health returns 502 from target before it times out.
Sam K: Can we isolate quick mitigation (traffic shift) while infra investigates noisy disks?
Maria V: I'll start a Route53 weighted-change to shift 35% traffic away from us-west-2 to us-west-1 and us-east-1 canaries. Doing it gradually.
Maria V: ```bash
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z3EXAMPLE 
--change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.example.redwood","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-west-2-weighted","Weight":65,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"34.12.34.12"}]}}]}'
```
Jordan P: While Maria does that I'm going to try to repro healthcheck locally and check dmesg/blkstat on affected instances. grabbing instance IDs now.
Jordan P: (paste) /var/log/messages: "blk_update_request: I/O error, dev xvdf, sector 123456" - a couple instances showing kernel IO errors.
Priya S: Good call. Ops, consider replacing affected instances with ephemeral-backed proxies (no EBS) if we can spin them quickly. Might reduce blast radius.
OpsBot: Started ASG replacement of instances in azc. New launch-config uses NVMe ephemeral root.
Sam K: Maria - route53 change applied?
Maria V: Applied incremental weights: us-west-2 -> 65%, us-west-1 -> 20%, us-east-1 -> 15%. Monitoring
Jordan P: Replaced 6 bad instances, detached noisy volumes for forensic capture. New instances passing ELB health checks. avg 5xx rate dropping.
Customer Ops: Customer-impact update: ~8% of requests to USW2 returned 502/503 between 17:24-17:40 UTC. No persistent data loss reported. Top affected tenants: org-133, org-542. Notifying support.
Sam K: Handoff: I'm going to bed. Jordan - take lead for mitigation and postmortem. Make sure we capture volume IDs for support.
Jordan P: Taking it. Will keep watch on traffic shaping and finalize mitigation.
Jordan P: Quick checklist executed: 1) ASG replaced bad instances 2) Noisy EBS volumes detached 3) Route53 weight shifted and then gradually restored once healthy 4) Additional ephemeral canary pool enabled.
Maria V: Rolling weights back to normal as healthy targets restored. us-west-2 -> 90%, us-west-1 -> 6%, us-east-1 -> 4%. No spikes in 5xx for last 12m.
Priya S: Making incident SEV2 official. Postmortem owner: Jordan. Please include timeline, root cause hypothesis (EBS noisy neighbor or kernel-level IO bug), mitigation steps, action items (ephemeral-backed proxies option, healthcheck tuning, ASG replacement policy), and customer comms.
IncidentBot: Incident P-7842 status -> SEV2, postmortem required.
Sam K: :thumbsup: Thanks team.
Jordan P: Adding final note - total customer impact window ~16 mins, mitigation window ~18 mins, no data corruption observed. Will draft postmortem and share in #incidents once ready.
Customer Ops: Notified affected customers with incident summary and ETA for postmortem.
Priya S: Closing live thread. Keep attachments (volume snapshots, kernel logs) in the incident ticket P-7842.
